title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/accessPackages
description: An access package. The resource name is the displayName, unique in the tenant (EARM refuses two packages with one name in any catalogs).

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

catalogId.description: Required on create, immutable: the catalog's object id, for example [reference('catalog').id].

isHidden.description: Whether the package is hidden from the My Access portal (requestable only by a direct link). Defaults to false on create.

permissions.notes: Learn (entitlementmanagement-post-accesspackages, accesspackage-update, accesspackage-delete): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission for writes, EntitlementManagement.Read.All for reads. Least privileged role: access package manager of the catalog (or catalog owner), or Identity Governance Administrator. A package with assignments cannot be deleted.
